mutants.description: Suppress the machine-level role hook while preserving filament and process hooks. The enabled export requires one ordered marker from each configured source on every observed role transition.
Route the process hook through the machine template. Distinct RH_MACHINE/RH_PROCESS markers and the required MACHINE/FILAMENT/PROCESS triplets should reject the wrong source template.
Drop the public one-based layer-number conversion. The first real role transition must publish a positive layer number within the emitted layer count.
